title: Finish Shuvr Rebrand and Security Hardening

questions.prompt: What should this goal consider complete?
questions.description: The current worktree has a partial rebrand/security implementation. This locks whether the goal should finish the full plan or stop at a release-ready subset.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Finish all remaining slices in PLAN-shuvr-rebrand-security-hardening.md, including docs/site/Nix/workflows/tests, and leave the task branch ready for commit after validation.

questions.prompt: How should historical docs and changelog entries be handled?
questions.description: The first implementation pass mechanically renamed historical Herdr references to Shuvr. This may be acceptable for a fork baseline, or it may need attribution/history cleanup.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Keep product-facing docs fully Shuvr, but review historical changelog/release notes for attribution correctness and avoid pretending old upstream releases were originally Shuvr releases.

questions.prompt: How should the goal handle the current Zig 0.15.2 validation blocker?
questions.description: Full Rust tests currently fail before project compilation because only Zig 0.16.0 is installed, and unpacking Zig 0.15.2 into /tmp failed once with no space left on device.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Treat full Rust validation as required: install or locate Zig 0.15.2 somewhere with enough space, run the repo validation, and only document a blocker if that still fails after reasonable attempts.

questions.prompt: Should the goal include commit and shared-checkout integration steps?
questions.description: AGENTS.md says task worktrees should commit on the task branch, then fast-forward the shared checkout and push origin/master, but only after commit message alignment.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Include commit preparation and proposed commit messages, but stop for explicit alignment before committing/integrating/pushing.
